title: Data tables for “Sediment cover in bedrock step-pool channels counter-intuitively increases with increasing water discharge”
description: The tables (Tables 1 to 3 and S1 to S17) of the paper “Sediment cover in bedrock step-pool channels counter-intuitively increases with increasing water discharge” by Albarran Ayala, Robinson, Takase, Inoue and Scheingross (Journal of Geophysical Research: Earth Surface, manuscript 2025JF008956R, in revision), one sheet per table, as revised for the second round of review in October 2026. Version 3 replaces the round 1 tables of version 2. README.md lists every sheet and its columns, and says what changed since version 2.
